subject.title: fix(extensions/msteams): bound Graph collection JSON response read to prevent OOM

question: Should this PR land as collection-only hardening, or should the same branch also bound the main Graph message JSON read in `downloadMSTeamsGraphMedia` before merge?
rationale: The collection fix is narrow and uses the established helper, but the same runtime flow still has an adjacent unbounded external Graph JSON read and an older broader PR is open; that scope choice should be intentional.

options.title: Require Same-Path Message Bound
options.body: Extend this PR or a replacement branch so both successful Graph JSON reads in the Teams attachment path use one bounded-reader policy before merge.

options.title: Land Collection-Only After Proof
options.body: Accept this as a narrow hostedContents fix after real behavior proof and track the main message read separately.

options.title: Continue With The Broader PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98833 as the vehicle after its cleanup and cap decision are resolved.

recommendation.title: Require Same-Path Message Bound
recommendation.body: Extend this PR or a replacement branch so both successful Graph JSON reads in the Teams attachment path use one bounded-reader policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently verified and merged the adjacent MS Teams bounded-reader fix and is the best available owner for the scope/cap tradeoff.
